research_mode: official Building Safety Regulator and GOV.UK primary guidance only; safety-case, mandatory-occurrence, building-assessment-certificate and registration methodology gates; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.name: Registration threshold
verified_claims: A high-rise residential structure has at least 7 floors or is at least 18 metres high and contains at least 2 residential units.
limitations: The threshold alone does not determine how connected structures must be registered.

sources.name: Connected-structure registration
verified_claims: Two or more structures may need to be registered as one building depending on connection and independent-section criteria.
limitations: Physical proximity alone is not enough to infer one registration.

sources.name: Registration excluded-use buildings
verified_claims: Buildings entirely used as hospitals, care homes, secure residential institutions, hotels, military premises or prisons are listed as not requiring this registration.
limitations: Mixed-use status or later changes require building-specific analysis.

sources.name: PAP registration responsibility
verified_claims: The PAP must make sure the high-rise residential building is registered.
limitations: The duty does not prove the current PAP has been correctly identified.

sources.name: Registration single point of contact
verified_claims: An organisational PAP must nominate a SPOC with authority to discuss building safety; the SPOC is not the PAP or an AP.
limitations: A nominated contact does not transfer statutory accountability.

sources.name: Individual PAP circumstances
verified_claims: An individual may be PAP in limited circumstances, such as ownership or lease responsibility for common-part maintenance.
limitations: Individual status must be supported by legal ownership or repair obligations.

sources.name: Registration authorised representative
verified_claims: The PAP may authorise another person in writing to register the building, without making that representative the PAP.
limitations: Authority to submit an application does not transfer PAP duties.

sources.name: Unregistered occupation offence
verified_claims: Allowing residents to occupy an unregistered high-rise residential building is an offence.
limitations: The rule does not establish whether a named building was occupied or registered on a particular date.

sources.name: New-building certificate gate
verified_claims: New buildings need the relevant completion or final certificate and registration before residents occupy them.
limitations: A certificate's existence does not prove all ongoing occupation-phase duties are met.

sources.name: Registration application fields
verified_claims: An application requires building identity and summary information plus PAP and AP contact details.
limitations: Submitted fields must not be treated as independently verified facts without BSR or source-document confirmation.

sources.name: Registration fee and invoice gate
verified_claims: The application fee is payable per building, and an unpaid invoice can prevent assessment and may lead to rejection.
limitations: A fee rule does not show that a particular application is paid or rejected.

sources.name: Registration floor-count method
verified_claims: Floors are counted from ground level to the top floor, with specified treatment for mezzanines and below-ground floors.
limitations: Floor count must follow the official measurement method rather than marketing descriptions.

sources.name: Registration height measurement
verified_claims: Height is measured from ground level to the top-floor surface, excluding the roof; qualifying buildings may use a recorded estimate in stated circumstances.
limitations: An estimate is not equivalent to a surveyed measurement.

sources.name: Registration units and completion details
verified_claims: All residential units are counted, and completion-certificate details or uploads depend on the building completion period.
limitations: Unit counts and completion dates require source documentation.

sources.name: Registration key information and change deadlines
verified_claims: Structure and fire-safety information is due within 28 days after application, while post-registration changes have specified 14-day or 28-day notification periods.
limitations: A notification deadline does not prove the underlying information is accurate or the change has been accepted.
